newsitem.title: HONG KONG: ONFEM buys Hong Kong engineering firm.
newsitem.headline: ONFEM buys Hong Kong engineering firm.

text.p: Property and industrial investment company ONFEM Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had acquired a 52 percent stake a Hong Kong engineer firm engaging in manufacturing and installing fire proof materials.
ONFEM refused to disclose the exact figure in acquiring Enful Engineering Ltd, but said the price was in a range from HK$20 million to HK$30 million.
"The addition of Enful will help reinforce our foothold in the specialist contracting industry," ONFEM managing director Fang Dacheng said in a statement.

"It will also promote cooperation amongst group members in technical and marketing aspects (such as joint contract tendering and customer referrals), thus sharpening the group's competitive edge," he said.
Enful, which had a turnover of HK$70 million last year, is engaged in manufacturing, distribution and installation of advanced passive fire proofing materials in Hong Kong and China.

Its main line of products include fire doors, fire partitioning, fire ceilings, fire resistance glazed system and structural fire proofing materials for commerical, industrial and residential buildings, ONFEM said.
